About the PVDF Butt Weld Tee

A tee makes a branch of the same size off a main line and carries full line pressure. Choose the pressure class to match the pipe.

About PVDF Fittings

PVDF fittings handle aggressive chemicals, solvents and higher temperatures than polypropylene. They are used in chemical processing, chlor-alkali service and high-purity lines in semiconductor and pharmaceutical plants.
